_comment: Option A motion (PROPOSED). Motion shows progress and state; nothing decorative.

page_transitions.note: cross-document View Transitions where supported; instant fallback

scroll_reveals.note: no generic fade-up on sections; content is visible immediately

skeleton_shimmer.scope: genuinely-async re-renders only, not general page loads

hero_animation.notes: Signature: the service 'path' line draws once on load (≤ 900ms) and the client-portal path fills to the current step. SVG stroke animation, CSS only — no animation library needed.

reduced_motion.note: Path renders fully drawn and static; toasts do not auto-dismiss.
